profileRequiredSections.title: Basis
contains: Intake package and exact entry ids

profileRequiredSections.title: Execution Context
contains: repository and local factory base and target
optional derived branch and linked worktree identity
versioned execution state and attempt history

profileRequiredSections.title: Acceptance and Verification
contains: conditional test criteria that record exact Human-requested tests or no tests authorized

profileRequiredSections.title: Execution
contains: optional test result or tests not run
mandatory Review Agent ACK and terminal receipt

profileRequiredSections.title: Human Review
contains: automatic integration and Human-decided PR promotion boundaries

profileRequiredSections.title: Report
contains: normalized integration result and registered raw receipt when integration occurs
Human-explicit verification result or tests not run

optionalSections.title: Release or Deployment
contains: release or deployment actions and evidence

blockGuidance: Use registered blocks for large logs, screenshots, and non-JSON execution evidence.
